description: DIAGNOSTIC configuration of the prospective nested optimization-budget intervention. Derived from the frozen r1 configuration annulus-poisson-hard-bc-v1 by exactly two changes: optimizer.steps 120000 -> 240000, and optimizer.lrPrefixSteps = 120000 added so the learning-rate schedule is a property of the method rather than of the requested budget. Architecture, collocation, batch size, optimizer settings, loss, geometry, thresholds and the localized acceptance contract are unchanged. This configuration is NOT a revision: it opens no claim set and produces no claim.

network.initialization: torch default (Kaiming uniform) under init seed

optimizer.name: Adam
optimizer.schedule: exponential decay lr -> finalLr over steps
optimizer.stopping: fixed step count; no early stopping (protocol L4)

sampling.rule: collocationCount pool indices drawn without replacement by the run's sampling seed; the pool is area-uniform interior points of the annulus (r = sqrt(a^2 + (R^2 - a^2) U), theta = 2 pi V). The count is the square experiment's, UNCHANGED: the EXPLORATORY probes showed that matching the collocation density to the larger annulus area (2823 points) does not improve the error at any step budget (1.05e-02 vs 9.94e-03 at 10k, 2.358e-03 vs 2.230e-03 at 40k), so raising it would have been a method change with no evidence behind it.

seedProtocol.rule: triplet i: init=initBase+i, sample=sampleBase+i, batch=batchBase+i, i in 0..runs-1; registered in seed_ledger.json before the first run. These bases are disjoint from the EXPLORATORY smoke bases (20261200 / 20261210 / 20261220).

claimPool.label: DAC
claimPool.rule: each member carries its own rotated geometry-native quadrature grid (integral criteria) and its own interior CGL-in-area-fraction pointwise grid (ACA-2, ACA-9). Angular counts are pairwise coprime and every member has a distinct angular offset, so no two members -- and no member and D_phys -- can share a node.

reproduction.rule: C_repro PASS requires BOTH the inherited absolute limit (|median_A - median_B| <= 1e-4) AND the relative limit (|median_A - median_B| <= 0.5 * median_A), plus an identical k/N verdict. Preregistered before the formal run; not chosen after seeing either median.

thresholdSources.acceptanceCriteria: ACA-1..ACA-9 thresholds, their geometry verdict (GEOMETRY-INVARIANT / GEOMETRY-SENSITIVE / NEW-GEOMETRY METRIC) and their source are frozen in pinn/governance/annulus_contract.py (THRESHOLD_SOURCES) and reproduced in the preregistration. epsilonSpec = the ACA-1 threshold.
thresholdSources.physics: PH1/PH2 are the flux and energy identities of the annulus, normalised by their own exact values (int f dA and the Dirichlet energy), thresholds 1e-2 as inherited; PH3 positivity tolerance 1e-3; PH6 (discrete maximum bound) 5e-3; PH7 is an SPD witness with an energy floor, cross-checked by the smallest eigenvalue of the independent polar operator. PH4 (symmetry) and PH5 (monotonicity) are registered NOT_APPLICABLE with reasons. All frozen before any formal training and before the claim pool was sealed.
thresholdSources.signatures: sPdeResidual uses the ACA-4 threshold on the dev residual; sBcResidual the ACA-3 threshold over BOTH components; sLocalizedError fires exactly when the preregistered localized acceptance criterion ACA-9 fails, under its contract's every-seed policy; sConservation the PH1 threshold; sSeedSensitive the Constitution 10.1 rules.
thresholdSources.stepBudget: The ONLY method value that differs from the square-2D calibration (10000 -> 120000). Raised before the freeze on EXPLORATORY evidence (D_dev only, claim pool not yet sealed): the carried-over budget leaves dev relative L2 at 9.94e-03, an order of magnitude above the inherited epsilon_spec = 1e-3, and the normalized residual at 4.14e-02 against ACA-4's 1e-2. Density-matched collocation does not help (1.05e-02), so the geometry's larger area is not the cause; the error falls by about 2.1x per doubling of the steps (9.94e-03 -> 5.43e-03 -> 2.36e-03 at 10k / 20k / 40k), i.e. the shortfall is the optimisation budget. 120000 steps is that scaling extrapolated to roughly 7e-04, about 1.4x of margin against epsilon_spec -- less margin than the square calibration had (23x), which is recorded here rather than bought by touching a threshold. If the formal run misses ACA-1 it is reported as a FAIL (user ruling 2026-09-17).

diagnostic.purpose: discriminate rOptimizationFailure from rCapacityLimit for sLocalizedError
